name: Build Approved Reels
description: Cuts every APPROVED moment in the reel plan onto its own Resolve timeline, bad takes removed, captions rendered through steps 4.01 and 4.05.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: Absolute path to the project. Whitelisted global injected by gather_step_inputs. The plan, the transcript and the Resolve binding are all read relative to it.

inputs.name: timeline_transcript
inputs.description: The master timeline's speech, REBUILT from source by `python3 -m library.tools.timeline_transcript <project> --write`. NO STEP PRODUCES IT - it needs Resolve open and WhisperX loaded - so it has no producing edge and reaches this step because the manifest declares it. Declaring it required is what derives requirements.timeline_transcript.on_file for this node.

inputs.name: skip_captions
inputs.description: Build the timelines without rendering subtitle overlays. The `--skip-captions` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`, which exists because the Remotion render is the expensive half and a structural check does not need it.

inputs.name: only_reels
inputs.description: Reel NUMBERS to build. Absent means every approved moment, which is what every build did before. The `--only-reel` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`. It exists because the delete step now removes only the names this call will place, so building one reel is a real operation rather than a full rebuild that happens to place one timeline.

inputs.name: timeline_name_suffix
inputs.description: Appended to the Resolve timeline name each reel is built INTO, and to the `timeline` component of every caption filename so the overlays cannot overwrite another timeline's. Absent means the plan's own name, which REPLACES the existing timeline of that name. The `--name-suffix` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`.

inputs.name: allow_drops
inputs.description: Rows the replace guard may let shrink, by ROW never by blanket (issue #925). Each entry is a `ROW` spec (`video:Semantic`, or the bare `Semantic`) applying to every reel this call promotes, or a `FINAL::ROW` spec for one reel only. The `--allow-drop` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`, repeatable. Absent means nothing is declared and any row that loses items, or vanishes, refuses the promotion.

inputs.name: supersede
inputs.description: Reels whose durable captain sign-off this build may replace (`library/tools/reel_signoff.py`). Each entry is a reel name in any container spelling. The `--supersede` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`, repeatable. Absent means nothing is declared and a promotion over a signed-off reel refuses by name, printing the declaration that would proceed deliberately. A declared supersession moves the sign-off to `superseded` after the rename lands; it is never deleted.

inputs.name: accept_editor_changes
inputs.description: Reels whose recorded unattributed editor changes the captain explicitly accepts superseding. The --accept-editor-changes REEL flag of manage_project.py build-reels, repeatable. Absent means an edit the staging does not already carry refuses promotion.

inputs.name: retain
inputs.description: Reels whose superseded generation the promotion may retire into the archive rather than delete (`library/tools/reel_retirement.py`). Each entry is a reel name in any container spelling. The `--retain` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`, repeatable. Absent - the default - means one timeline per reel and an empty archive; a reel carrying a sign-off retires whatever this says.

inputs.name: rebuild_all
inputs.description: Place every reel this run names, whatever the state says. Absent - the default - means a reel nothing changed about is LEFT ALONE (`library/tools/reel_rebuild_need.py`): the decision compares the derivation this build computed and the live timeline read back against what the build that placed it recorded, and is fail-closed in every other case. A reel's Resolve pass is 19.4-67.1s of which the Fusion comp pass is fixed overhead (`docs/RULE_EVIDENCE.md`), so re-placing an unchanged reel costs that and produces the same frames. The `--rebuild-all` flag of `manage_project.py build-reels`.

outputs.name: reel_build
outputs.description: What was PLACED: the timelines built, the plan they were built from, the caption content hashes recorded at build time, and the Resolve names built into. Carried by the edge to verify_reels so the verifier grades the same answer the build wrote. Also carries what the build was ASKED for - `reels_requested` and `name_suffix` - so a record of one reel built into a new container does not read as a full rebuild that placed one timeline. `rebuild_need` carries the per-reel decision and its reason, and `reels_left_alone` names the reels that needed no Resolve pass - which is not the same list as `skipped_by_exclusion`.

metadata.author: prajwal
metadata.notes: Belongs to library/processes/reels, not to edit_video. See docs/REEL_BUILD_HAS_NO_OWNING_NODE.md for the measurement that says why a reel build cannot be a node of the edit_video DAG.
